{{Quote|The Ur'kossags? Tried to recruit me away from the refugees. Said I'd be better off with them. They had credits, food, cute little clubhouse. All I'd have to do is kill a rival gangster.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Merciful One">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Kira Carsen|The Merciful One}}</ref>}}
A '''gangster''' was a rival of the [[Ur'kossags]], a criminal gang on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the Ur'kossags attempted to recruit the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] teenager [[Kira Carsen]], they offered her membership if she would [[Death/Legends|kill]] the gangster, but Carsen ultimately refused the offer.<ref name="Merciful One" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ur'kossags' rival was first mentioned in the conversation "The Merciful One" with Kira Carsen, a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Merciful One" />
